bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Site grading standards pitch turf and soil at a 2 percent minimum slope (0.25 inch per foot) away from building foundations for 10 feet.
core_mechanism_bullets: Site grading standards pitch turf and soil at a 2 percent minimum slope (0.25 inch per foot) away from building foundations for 10 feet.
ADA accessible walkways maintain a cross-slope under 2 percent and a running slope under 5 percent, or up to 8.33 percent on ramps.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: Over a 20-foot lawn run away from a camp nature center foundation, a 2 percent drainage grade drops the soil elevation by 0.4 feet (4.8 inches) into a vegetated bioswale.

primary_source_citation.title: ASLA Microclimate Windbreak & Solar Canopy Standard Technical Reference

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Deciduous shade trees on south and west building walls block up to 75 percent of summer solar heat while bare winter branches warm rooms.
core_mechanism_bullets: Deciduous shade trees on south and west building walls block up to 75 percent of summer solar heat while bare winter branches warm rooms.
Evergreen conifer windbreaks on the winter windward side cut wind speed across a leeward zone extending 10 to 15 times the tree height.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: A row of 20-foot Norway spruce trees planted upwind on the northwest border of a cabin shelters a leeward yard extending 200 to 300 feet downwind and cuts heating energy loss by 20 percent.
bespoke_clusters.counselor_tabletop_demo: Sketch a microclimate planting diagram around a building showing summer afternoon sun angles, winter prevailing wind vectors, and deciduous versus evergreen placement.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: The USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map divides North America into 13 zones by 10 degrees Fahrenheit average annual minimum winter temperature.

Landscape plans draw trees and shrubs at 75 to 100 percent of mature crown diameter rather than nursery pot size to prevent crowding.
